text: AI is changing the workplace in many ways. One important change is automation. Machines and software can now do repetitive tasks, such as sorting emails or checking data. This saves time and reduces mistakes. There are also many productivity tools that help workers plan their day, organise meetings, and write reports faster. However, AI is not here to replace people completely. In fact, human-AI collaboration is becoming more common. Workers use AI to support their decisions, while people still bring creativity and emotional skills. Of course, some jobs are changing or disappearing, so employees need to learn new skills to stay competitive in a modern workplace.
